stateCondition.filterFn: (bookId, data) => { const shelfItem = (data.shelf || []).find(x => x.bookId === bookId); if (shelfItem && shelfItem.isPrivate === true) return false; const progress = data.bookProgress?.[bookId]; const book = (data.store || []).find(b => b.id === bookId); return !!(progress && book && progress.charOffset >= book.totalWords); }
